decisions.reason: As a low-pile decorative carpet, it is far from the firm's furniture-related knowledge, limiting its absorptive capacity to interpret early results and improve the product.
Hand-knotted wool silk carpet requires specialized textile craftsmanship outside the firm's furniture expertise, making it difficult to assimilate new information and learn from market feedback.
Similar to Product A, this low-pile decorative carpet does not build on existing furniture knowledge, reducing the firm's ability to recognize and apply improvement opportunities.
A corner bench builds directly on the firm's wood processing and seating knowledge, enabling it to interpret early results and apply its existing capabilities to improve the product.
Low-pile carpet is unrelated to furniture manufacturing, so the firm lacks the related knowledge needed to learn from early feedback and enhance the product.
The swivel shell chair aligns with the firm's seating and material expertise, allowing it to assimilate early results and apply its absorptive capacity to refine the product.
